question: Who among the following was honoured with the 2020 Nobel Prize for Literature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Louise Gluck.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Poet and essayist** Louise Elisabeth Glück is **American.**
 
• The **2020 Nobel Prize in Literature **went to her.
 
• Judges praised her as "**her unmistakable poetic voice that with austere beauty makes individual existence universal".**
 
• Her most well-known poem is **"Mock Orange".**
 
• A couple of her best-known poems are** "The Wild Iris" and "The Triumph of Achilles."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alice Munro:**

 
 
• A** Canadian short story writer** named Alice Ann Munro won the **2013 Nobel Prize for Literature.**
 
 
 
• **Doris Lessing:**
 
 
• **British author **Doris Lessing wrote novels. The body of work by Doris Lessing consists of about** 50 novels and is diverse in genre.**
 
 
 
• **Kazuo Ishiguro:**
 
 
• Kazuo Ishiguro was awarded a **knighthood by the British Queen in 2018** after winning the **2017 Nobel Prize for Literature. **
 
• The books The **Remains of the Day and Never Let Me Go **are among his best-known works.
